subject.title: Vera wake word keeps capturing after conversation ends, causing cross-talk with other speakers

question: Should Vera use a fixed canonical post-turn shutdown policy, or should Android expose a user-configurable wake-word keep-alive timeout alongside that policy?
rationale: The report combines a likely lifecycle defect with a new persistent voice-settings control; source and current behavior must be verified before choosing the lasting user contract.

options.title: Define fixed shutdown first
options.body: Repair explicit session cleanup and terminal-state handling first, then add configuration only if a validated use case remains.

options.title: Add an advanced timeout setting
options.body: Define a documented default, valid range, upgrade behavior, and how it composes with End, silence, and agent-turn completion.

recommendation.title: Define fixed shutdown first
recommendation.body: Repair explicit session cleanup and terminal-state handling first, then add configuration only if a validated use case remains.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context only identifies the reporter; repository history could not be inspected to route this to the Android voice feature owner.
